_readme: Preset for one end-to-end synthetic dataset run. Copy this file, change what
you want, and pass it to scripts/generate_rrf_dataset.py --preset <file>.
The exact preset used is copied into the run's output directory, so any batch
can be traced back to the settings that produced it — and reproduced.
Stages run in order and each can be skipped independently, so a re-run can
reuse expensive artifacts: point profile_run at an existing directory and set
generate_profiles.enabled=false to re-pair a pool you already paid to make.

generate_profiles._note: Prompts come from LangSmith Hub. Pin PROFILE_GEN_PROMPT_GENERATE to a v3+ tag: the LANGSMITH_PROMPT_TAG=v1 fallback resolves to the pre-fix prompt that still expects {ref_example_1} and fails on every profile.

_profile_run: null = use the run just generated; set a path to reuse an existing pool

pairing._seeker_frac: share of the pool acting as seekers; disjoint from candidates. 0.43 matches the real data, where only 3.4% of contacts are ever both.
pairing._top_k: shortlist depth sent to the judge. Fixing this keeps the label's meaning stable — 'best of 5' is a weaker claim than 'best of 10' — so change it deliberately, not to save money.
pairing._weights: 2:1 tracks the measured retrieval gap on the real holdout (dense MRR 0.4610 vs lexical 0.2939). Do not tune these on a synthetic batch — it has no ground truth, so you would only be fitting the judge's opinions.
pairing._max_pairs_per_seeker: null = uncapped. Set to ~1 to hold graph density near real data's 0.673 edges/node, at the cost of discarding judged pairs.
pairing._min_dense_similarity: absolute cosine floor, off by default. A meaningful value must be calibrated against real pairs; taking one from this batch's own distribution repeats the --label-mode absolute mistake.

embedding._backend: modal | local. Any 7-8B model needs modal — it will not fit on local MPS, and an A10G OOMs.

judge._note: Model, framing and prompt are fixed in judge.py and the hub prompt: google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite, naive framing, one call per pair, no deadband. All three are measured choices — see docs/llm-judge-experiment.md before changing any of them.

export._dest: a git-TRACKED path. artifacts/ is gitignored, which is how the previous profile batch was lost.
export._include_embeddings: vectors are large; the manifest and labels always go, embeddings only on request.
